# North Star

<!-- Generated by .github/workflows/north-star.yml (tools/north-star) from refs/ishoo/store. Do not edit: change the north star in Ishoo. -->

This is the project north star held in Ishoo (`ishoo_north_star op:show`), version 5, set 2026-10-20. Earlier versions are in `ishoo_north_star op:history`.

## Promise

Fractodactyl aims to be the fastest deep-zoom generator that shows the real Mandelbrot set and looks visually perfect to humans: longer, deeper and more striking zoom films than anything else can make, and an explorer that feels magically live at any depth.

## Ambition

When deep zooms become fast and cheap, new uses emerge on their own; we aim to usher in that era. Any method is fair game; the evidence picks the path and drops ideas that stop paying. Precision nobody can see is a cost, not a feature. Speed is a means: films should look like nothing made before, and exploring should feel instant and alive like no other explorer.

## Tests

Every idea must pass all of these, in order, to belong:

1. Real: the frame shows the actual Mandelbrot set at that location and depth.
2. Looks perfect: viewers cannot tell a film frame from an exact render of the same frame, measured, not eyeballed.
3. Moves the outcome: it makes zooms faster, deeper, longer or more striking, makes the explorer feel more live, or unblocks something that does.

## Where it stops

Depth is never faked: no swapping in a look-alike location, and no skipping work a viewer would see.

## The bar

Absurdly expensive zooms render routinely; depth and length stop limiting a zoom. Video is the main product, with looks and motion nobody else offers. The live explorer feels real-time at every depth: every move answers instantly, never waiting for a picture. Exact full-accuracy renders stay available as stills for maths and science.
